name: @inid/node
description: InID for an organization's Node.js server: exchange tokens for the buyer's data, verify webhooks and sign requests with your server key. No dependencies.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && ../../node_modules/.bin/esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --target=node18 --outfile=dist/index.js && ../../node_modules/.bin/tsc src/index.ts --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2022 --skipLibCheck --types node
